stats.source: GOB 71 supplies function-2 Healing Bonus 1141 and Sweep Bonus 1052 while loaded.
stats.runtime: AbilityPassives maintains both rank-scaled records. Healing reads the linked 1141 total and the sweep snapshots the live 1052 total.
stats.test: [Native PR676](https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/676#issuecomment-7065776933) observed the two +1 records and Group Repairs 8 to 9. [Native PR815](https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/815#issuecomment-7086057679) recorded the source-71 1052 round trip.

consumer.source: NegativeConditionSweepPulse removes eligible debuff parents when the d100 draw is below the pulse's value. Stat 1052 is the separate shipped Sweep Bonus.
consumer.runtime: The live linked bonus is snapshotted from the caster as added whole percentage points. The published 320 effect value remains 18.
consumer.test: [Native PR815](https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/815#issuecomment-7086057679) observed 36 to 37 and 33 to 34 when source 71 was present, with a roll of 33 demonstrating the second boundary.

source-parity.source: The shipped d100 callback uses a strict threshold and GOB 71 provides a separate rank-scaled Sweep Bonus.
source-parity.runtime: The compatible server interpretation adds the linked bonus in percentage points to the chance, retaining the stored visible effect.
source-parity.test: The [stock four-way comparison](https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/815#issuecomment-7086057679) holds base 18 and roll 33 constant. The one-point 71 comparison changes the removal outcome.

behavior-tests.source: GOB 71 defines healing and sweep only while loaded.
behavior-tests.runtime: Healing and ordinary sweep use their matching totals and Archive removal is source-specific.
behavior-tests.test: SweepPassiveRetainsItsOtherTypedConsumers checks healing. CasterSweepBonusSnapshotsAWholeChancePointWithoutChangingThePublishedValue tests independent removal, direct Sweep and party Sweep. Stock PR676 and PR815 cover both linked consumers.

stats.source: GOB 370 stores function-2 bonuses for melee defense 1143, ballistic defense 1027, healing 1141 and sweep 1052 while loaded.
stats.runtime: AbilityPassives applies each record. Typed defenses, heal scaling and the caster's sweep snapshot read their corresponding totals.
stats.test: [Native PR755](https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/755#issuecomment-7081754805) observed all four +1 records round-trip. [Native PR815](https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/815#issuecomment-7086057679) separately observed rank-30 1052 +3 and its removal and reload.

consumer.source: The shipped sweep callback uses a strict d100 threshold, and 370 supplies the rank-dependent sweep bonus.
consumer.runtime: The caster's linked 1052 is snapshotted into the removal chance without changing the stock sweep effect record.
consumer.test: [Native PR815](https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/815#issuecomment-7086057679) observed 34 to 37 and 33 to 36 when source 370 was present. The second comparison clears the stock Slow at the same roll of 33.

source-parity.source: The shipped d100 sweep callback and 370's rank-scaled linked bonus support adding whole chance points.
source-parity.runtime: The server adds the three linked points before the strict draw test and leaves the published effect value at its GOB base.
source-parity.test: The [stock four-way comparison](https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/815#issuecomment-7086057679) verified the exact threshold and the natural 28 s lifetime of the control Slow.

behavior-tests.source: All four rank-scaled bonuses are active while 370 is loaded.
behavior-tests.runtime: The passive changes its individual defense, healing and sweep consumers and removes each contribution independently.
behavior-tests.test: SweepPassiveRetainsItsOtherTypedConsumers tests actual heal and defense values. CasterSweepBonusSnapshotsAWholeChancePointWithoutChangingThePublishedValue tests both ordinary sweep forms. Stock PR755 and PR815 verify transitions and the live sweep outcome.
